1400	def prove_inclusion(leaves: Sequence[bytes], index: int) -> MerkleProof:
1401	    """Build a :class:`MerkleProof` for the leaf at zero-based ``index``.
1402	
1403	    Duplicate leaves are located purely by position; content is never searched.
1404	    """
1405	    items = _checked_leaves(leaves)
1406	    _check_merkle_index(index, len(items))
1407	    level = [_leaf_digest(leaf) for leaf in items]
1408	    siblings: list[bytes] = []
1409	    position = index
1410	    while len(level) > 1:
1411	        if len(level) % 2 == 1:
1412	            level = level + [level[-1]]
1413	        siblings.append(level[position ^ 1])
1414	        level = [
1415	            _node_digest(level[offset], level[offset + 1])
1416	            for offset in range(0, len(level), 2)
1417	        ]
1418	        position //= 2
1419	    return MerkleProof(index=index, siblings=tuple(siblings))
1420	
1421	
1422	def verify_inclusion(leaf: bytes, proof: MerkleProof, root: bytes) -> bool:
1423	    """Check that ``leaf`` sits at ``proof.index`` under Merkle ``root``.
1424	
1425	    Type errors raise :class:`TypeError`; malformed digest lengths or an
1426	    index/path structure that cannot correspond to a real tree return False.
1427	    """
1428	    _check_bytes(leaf, "leaf")
1429	    _check_bytes(root, "root")
1430	    if not isinstance(proof, MerkleProof):
1431	        raise TypeError("proof must be a MerkleProof")
1432	    if not isinstance(proof.index, int) or isinstance(proof.index, bool):
1433	        raise TypeError("proof index must be an integer")
1434	    if not isinstance(proof.siblings, tuple):
1435	        raise TypeError("proof siblings must be a tuple of bytes")
1436	    for sibling in proof.siblings:
1437	        _check_bytes(sibling, "proof sibling")
1438	    if len(root) != _MERKLE_DIGEST_SIZE:
1439	        return False
1440	    if proof.index < 0:
1441	        return False
1442	    if any(len(sibling) != _MERKLE_DIGEST_SIZE for sibling in proof.siblings):
1443	        return False
1444	    digest = _leaf_digest(leaf)
1445	    position = proof.index
1446	    for sibling in proof.siblings:
1447	        if position % 2 == 0:
1448	            digest = _node_digest(digest, sibling)
1449	        else:
1450	            digest = _node_digest(sibling, digest)
1451	        position //= 2
1452	    if position != 0:
1453	        return False  # index deeper than the path allows
1454	    return hmac.compare_digest(digest, root)
1455	
1456	
1457	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1458	# Compact Merkle multi-inclusion proofs
1459	#
1460	# Same digests and odd-node duplication as the single-leaf proofs above, but
1461	# one proof covers several leaves at once: siblings shared by two proven
1462	# nodes are collected only once, and a sibling that is itself proven (or an
1463	# odd last node that duplicates itself) is never collected at all.
1464	
1465	
1466	@dataclass(frozen=True)
1467	class MerkleMultiProof:
1468	    """Multi-inclusion proof for ``indices`` within ``leaf_count`` leaves.
1469	
1470	    ``siblings`` lists the digests the verifier cannot recompute, ordered
1471	    level by level from leaf to root and left to right within each level.
1472	    """
1473	
1474	    leaf_count: int
1475	    indices: tuple[int, ...]
1476	    siblings: tuple[bytes, ...]
1477	
1478	
1479	def _checked_multi_indices(indices: Sequence[int], size: int) -> list[int]:
1480	    if isinstance(indices, (bytes, bytearray, str)) or not isinstance(indices, Sequence):
1481	        raise TypeError("indices must be a sequence of integers")
1482	    items = list(indices)  # copy: inputs are never mutated
1483	    if not items:
1484	        raise ValueError("indices must not be empty")
1485	    previous: int | None = None
1486	    for position, index in enumerate(items):
1487	        if not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool):
1488	            raise TypeError(f"indices[{position}] must be an integer")
1489	        if previous is not None and index <= previous:
1490	            raise ValueError("indices must be strictly increasing without duplicates")
1491	        previous = index
1492	    for index in items:
1493	        if not 0 <= index < size:
1494	            raise IndexError(f"index {index} out of range for {size} leaves")
1495	    return items
1496	
1497	
1498	def prove_multi_inclusion(leaves: Sequence[bytes], indices: Sequence[int]) -> MerkleMultiProof:
1499	    """Build a compact :class:`MerkleMultiProof` for the leaves at ``indices``.
1500	
1501	    ``indices`` must be non-empty, strictly increasing and duplicate-free.
1502	    The proof is deterministic and minimal: when every leaf is proven,
1503	    ``siblings`` is empty.
1504	    """
1505	    items = _checked_leaves(leaves)
1506	    positions = _checked_multi_indices(indices, len(items))
1507	    level = [_leaf_digest(leaf) for leaf in items]
1508	    siblings: list[bytes] = []
1509	    known = positions
1510	    while len(level) > 1:
1511	        size = len(level)
1512	        known_set = set(known)
1513	        for position in known:  # ascending: siblings collected left to right
1514	            sibling = position ^ 1
1515	            if sibling in known_set:
1516	                continue  # sibling is proven too, nothing to collect
1517	            if position == size - 1 and size % 2 == 1:
1518	                continue  # odd last node duplicates itself
1519	            siblings.append(level[sibling])
1520	        if size % 2 == 1:
1521	            level = level + [level[-1]]
1522	        level = [
1523	            _node_digest(level[offset], level[offset + 1])
1524	            for offset in range(0, len(level), 2)
1525	        ]
1526	        known = sorted({position // 2 for position in known})
1527	    return MerkleMultiProof(
1528	        leaf_count=len(items),
1529	        indices=tuple(positions),
1530	        siblings=tuple(siblings),
1531	    )
1532	
1533	
1534	def verify_multi_inclusion(
1535	    entries: Sequence[tuple[int, bytes]],
1536	    proof: MerkleMultiProof,
1537	    root: bytes,
1538	) -> bool:
1539	    """Check ``entries`` against ``proof`` and Merkle ``root`` without the full leaf set.
1540	
1541	    ``entries`` holds one ``(index, leaf)`` pair per entry, in the exact order
1542	    of ``proof.indices``. Type errors raise :class:`TypeError`; empty,
1543	    misordered, out-of-range, miscounted or tampered inputs return False.
1544	    """
1545	    _check_bytes(root, "root")
1546	    if not isinstance(proof, MerkleMultiProof):
1547	        raise TypeError("proof must be a MerkleMultiProof")
1548	    if not isinstance(proof.leaf_count, int) or isinstance(proof.leaf_count, bool):
1549	        raise TypeError("proof leaf_count must be an integer")
1550	    if not isinstance(proof.indices, tuple):
1551	        raise TypeError("proof indices must be a tuple of integers")
1552	    for index in proof.indices:
1553	        if not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool):
1554	            raise TypeError("proof indices must be a tuple of integers")
1555	    if not isinstance(proof.siblings, tuple):
1556	        raise TypeError("proof siblings must be a tuple of bytes")
1557	    for sibling in proof.siblings:
1558	        _check_bytes(sibling, "proof sibling")
1559	    if isinstance(entries, (bytes, bytearray, str)) or not isinstance(entries, Sequence):
1560	        raise TypeError("entries must be a sequence of (index, leaf) pairs")
1561	    pairs: list[tuple[int, bytes]] = []
1562	    for position, entry in enumerate(entries):
1563	        if not isinstance(entry, (tuple, list)) or len(entry) != 2:
1564	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] must be an (index, leaf) pair")
1565	        index, leaf = entry
1566	        if not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool):
1567	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] index must be an integer")
1568	        if not isinstance(leaf, bytes):
1569	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] leaf must be bytes")
1570	        pairs.append((index, leaf))
1571	    if proof.leaf_count < 1:
1572	        return False
1573	    if not proof.indices:
1574	        return False
1575	    if any(
1576	        later <= earlier for earlier, later in zip(proof.indices, proof.indices[1:])
1577	    ):
1578	        return False  # duplicates or out-of-order indices
1579	    if proof.indices[0] < 0 or proof.indices[-1] >= proof.leaf_count:
1580	        return False
1581	    if not pairs:
1582	        return False
1583	    if tuple(index for index, _ in pairs) != proof.indices:
1584	        return False
1585	    if len(root) != _MERKLE_DIGEST_SIZE:
1586	        return False
1587	    if any(len(sibling) != _MERKLE_DIGEST_SIZE for sibling in proof.siblings):
1588	        return False
1589	    known = {index: _leaf_digest(leaf) for index, leaf in pairs}
1590	    size = proof.leaf_count
1591	    siblings = proof.siblings
1592	    cursor = 0
1593	    while size > 1:
1594	        next_known: dict[int, bytes] = {}
1595	        for position in sorted(known):
1596	            sibling = position ^ 1
1597	            if sibling in known:
1598	                sibling_digest = known[sibling]
1599	            elif position == size - 1 and size % 2 == 1:
1600	                sibling_digest = known[position]  # odd last node duplicates itself
1601	            else:
1602	                if cursor >= len(siblings):
1603	                    return False  # proof ran out of siblings
1604	                sibling_digest = siblings[cursor]
1605	                cursor += 1
1606	            if position % 2 == 0:
1607	                digest = _node_digest(known[position], sibling_digest)
1608	            else:
1609	                digest = _node_digest(sibling_digest, known[position])
1610	            next_known[position // 2] = digest
1611	        known = next_known
1612	        size = (size + 1) // 2
1613	    if cursor != len(siblings):
1614	        return False  # every sibling must be consumed
1615	    return hmac.compare_digest(known[0], root)
1616	
1617	
1618	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1619	# Merkle-committed Schnorr batches
1620	#
1621	# A complete multi-key Schnorr batch frozen together with the Merkle proof
1622	# that commits to every entry. Each Merkle leaf is the established Schnorr
1623	# Fiat-Shamir transcript (seven length-framed items) with one extra framed
1624	# item appended: the shortest unsigned big-endian encoding of the proof
1625	# response. Verification first checks every leaf against the Merkle root,
1626	# then runs the unchanged multi-key batch signature verification.
1627	
1628	
1629	@dataclass(frozen=True)
1630	class BoundSchnorrBatch:
1631	    """A complete Schnorr batch bound to a Merkle multi-inclusion proof.
1632	
1633	    Fields, in order: ``entries`` — a tuple of :class:`MultiSchnorrEntry`;
1634	    ``leaf_count`` — a positive, non-``bool`` integer equal to both
1635	    ``len(entries)`` and ``proof.leaf_count``; ``proof`` — the
1636	    :class:`MerkleMultiProof` whose indices cover ``0 .. leaf_count - 1``
1637	    without gaps or duplicates. All three are positional construction
1638	    arguments; batches compare by value and are immutable.
1639	    """
1640	
1641	    entries: tuple[MultiSchnorrEntry, ...]
1642	    leaf_count: int
1643	    proof: MerkleMultiProof
1644	
1645	
1646	def _bound_schnorr_leaf(entry: MultiSchnorrEntry) -> bytes:
1647	    """Build the Merkle leaf committed for one :class:`MultiSchnorrEntry`.
1648	
1649	    The leaf is the seven Fiat-Shamir transcript items — domain separator,
1650	    ``prime``, ``generator``, ``public_key``, commitment, ``context`` and
1651	    ``message`` — each prefixed with its four-byte unsigned big-endian
1652	    length (integers in shortest unsigned big-endian encoding), followed by
1653	    the response framed the same way.
1654	    """
1655	    items = (
1656	        _FS_DOMAIN,
1657	        _encode_int(entry.prime),
1658	        _encode_int(entry.generator),
1659	        _encode_int(entry.public_key),
1660	        _encode_int(entry.proof.commitment),
1661	        entry.context,
1662	        entry.message,
1663	        _encode_int(entry.proof.response),
1664	    )
1665	    leaf = bytearray()
1666	    for item in items:
1667	        leaf += len(item).to_bytes(4, "big")
1668	        leaf += item
1669	    return bytes(leaf)
1670	
1671	
1672	def verify_bound(
1673	    batch: BoundSchnorrBatch,
1674	    root: bytes,
1675	    *,
1676	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
1677	) -> bool:
1678	    """Verify a Merkle-committed complete :class:`BoundSchnorrBatch`.
1679	
1680	    The Merkle binding is checked first: every entry is encoded to its leaf
1681	    exactly as specified by :func:`_bound_schnorr_leaf` and the whole batch
1682	    is checked against ``root`` with :func:`verify_multi_inclusion`.
1683	    ``leaf_count`` must be a positive, non-``bool`` integer equal to both
1684	    ``len(entries)`` and ``proof.leaf_count``, and ``proof.indices`` must
1685	    cover ``0 .. leaf_count - 1`` with no gaps, duplicates or reordering;
1686	    an empty batch, a missing entry or any index mismatch returns ``False``.
1687	    Only after the root checks does the batch go through
1688	    :func:`verify_schnorr_batch` with the same ``randbelow``, under its
1689	    unchanged randomness contract: it is called once per structurally
1690	    valid entry as ``randbelow(prime - 1)``.
1691	
1692	    Type errors — a batch that is not a :class:`BoundSchnorrBatch`,
1693	    non-tuple entries, non-:class:`MultiSchnorrEntry` items, a non-integer
1694	    or ``bool`` ``leaf_count``, a wrong proof/root object, malformed nested
1695	    field types, or a non-callable ``randbelow`` — raise
1696	    :class:`TypeError`; every other invalidity (including bad randomness
1697	    outcomes surfaced by :func:`verify_schnorr_batch` per its own contract)
1698	    behaves exactly as the delegated calls do. Inputs are never mutated.
1699	    """
1700	    if not isinstance(batch, BoundSchnorrBatch):
1701	        raise TypeError("batch must be a BoundSchnorrBatch")
1702	    _check_bytes(root, "root")
1703	    if not callable(randbelow):
1704	        raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
1705	    entries = batch.entries
1706	    if not isinstance(entries, tuple):
1707	        raise TypeError("batch entries must be a tuple of MultiSchnorrEntry")
1708	    leaf_count = batch.leaf_count
1709	    if not isinstance(leaf_count, int) or isinstance(leaf_count, bool):
1710	        raise TypeError("batch leaf_count must be an integer")
1711	    proof = batch.proof
1712	    if not isinstance(proof, MerkleMultiProof):
1713	        raise TypeError("batch proof must be a MerkleMultiProof")
1714	    if not isinstance(proof.leaf_count, int) or isinstance(proof.leaf_count, bool):
1715	        raise TypeError("proof leaf_count must be an integer")
1716	    if not isinstance(proof.indices, tuple):
1717	        raise TypeError("proof indices must be a tuple of integers")
1718	    for index in proof.indices:
1719	        if not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool):
1720	            raise TypeError("proof indices must be a tuple of integers")
1721	    if not isinstance(proof.siblings, tuple):
1722	        raise TypeError("proof siblings must be a tuple of bytes")
1723	    for sibling in proof.siblings:
1724	        _check_bytes(sibling, "proof sibling")
1725	    for position, entry in enumerate(entries):
1726	        if not isinstance(entry, MultiSchnorrEntry):
1727	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] must be a MultiSchnorrEntry")
1728	        _check_int(entry.public_key, f"entries[{position}] public_key")
1729	        _check_bytes(entry.message, f"entries[{position}] message")
1730	        entry_proof = entry.proof
1731	        if not isinstance(entry_proof, SchnorrProof):
1732	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof must be a SchnorrProof")
1733	        if (
1734	            not isinstance(entry_proof.commitment, int)
1735	            or isinstance(entry_proof.commitment, bool)
1736	            or not isinstance(entry_proof.response, int)
1737	            or isinstance(entry_proof.response, bool)
1738	        ):
1739	            raise TypeError(
1740	                f"entries[{position}] proof commitment and response must be integers"
1741	            )
1742	        _check_bytes(entry.context, f"entries[{position}] context")
1743	        _check_int(entry.prime, f"entries[{position}] prime")
1744	        _check_int(entry.generator, f"entries[{position}] generator")
1745	
1746	    if leaf_count < 1:
1747	        return False
1748	    if leaf_count != len(entries) or leaf_count != proof.leaf_count:
1749	        return False
1750	    if proof.indices != tuple(range(leaf_count)):
1751	        return False  # empty coverage, gaps, duplicates or reordering
1752	
1753	    # The leaf encoding is unsigned, so a negative integer cannot be framed;
1754	    # every other structural check (group parameters, ranges) is left to
1755	    # verify_schnorr_batch so the Merkle root is always examined first.
1756	    for entry in entries:
1757	        if min(
1758	            entry.prime,
1759	            entry.generator,
1760	            entry.public_key,
1761	            entry.proof.commitment,
1762	            entry.proof.response,
1763	        ) < 0:
1764	            return False
1765	
1766	    leaves = [_bound_schnorr_leaf(entry) for entry in entries]
1767	
1768	    # 1) the Merkle root commits to every entry leaf, then
1769	    # 2) the unchanged multi-key batch verification checks the signatures
1770	    if not verify_multi_inclusion(list(enumerate(leaves)), proof, root):
1771	        return False
1772	    return verify_schnorr_batch(entries, randbelow=randbelow)
